summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of the Australia Wire quiz app. Backend: 8 pytest cases (questions shape/shuffle/correct-answer integrity, leaderboard CRUD+sort+validation, AI regenerate) — 7/8 passed. Frontend: load/dark-mode/dashboard, instant feedback + per-question lock, live score & progress, all 5 company filters, search, 4 status filters, both submit buttons, summary modal + per-company breakdown, save-to-leaderboard, leaderboard modal, theme toggle, reset — all passed. Single blocking defect: POST /api/regenerate-questions takes ~70s and is killed by the ingress gateway with 502, so the AI Regenerate button always fails for users.

critical.issue: Works on localhost:8001 (200, ~70s, 41 questions) but always returns 502 Bad gateway through the public ingress (edge timeout ~60s). UI 'AI Regenerate' therefore always shows 'AI generation failed'. Fix: split into 5 concurrent per-company LLM calls (8 Qs each) via asyncio.gather so total latency drops under ~30s, or move to a background job + polling.

minor.issue: LLM returned 41 questions (WiseTech 9) — no per-company cap/trim to exactly 8x5=40, so counts can be unbalanced. Add per-company slicing to 8.
Response exposes Mongo document key as `_id` alias (string uuid, not ObjectId, so no serialization error) — consider returning `id` for consistency with the rest of the API.

integration_issues.issue: Click on AI Regenerate -> 502 after ~60s -> error toast 'AI generation failed — try again'. Error handling is graceful but the feature is unusable through the public URL.

issues: Option lists are bottom-aligned within equal-height cards, leaving a large empty gap between the question text and options on shorter questions (see 3-line vs 1-line question cards in the same row).
progress-bar element has no aria-valuenow/role=progressbar attributes (minor a11y/testability gap; visual percentage text is correct).

action_items: CRITICAL: Make /api/regenerate-questions finish in <55s (parallel per-company LLM calls with asyncio.gather) so the ingress does not 502; re-verify via public URL.
Trim/normalize AI output to exactly 8 questions per company (40 total).
Optional: include option text in the search filter (search currently matches question+category only, so 'Judo Bank' returns 0 results).
Optional: add role=progressbar/aria-valuenow to the dashboard progress bar.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py regenerate endpoint is a single long blocking LLM request with no timeout budget awareness — it exceeds the platform gateway timeout; parallelize per company and add a per-call timeout with partial-result fallback.
No cap on questions per company after AI validation loop (len(result) only checked >= 20), allowing unbalanced sets like 9 WiseTech / 8 others.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass except AI regenerate which is blocked by the backend timeout)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_* leaderboard attempts (TEST_qa_user, TEST_sort_*, TEST_ui_reporter). Pre-existing 'Test Reporter 32/40' entry from the main agent was left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Company filter/summary breakdown testids are LOWERCASE (company-filter-anz|star|santos|riotinto|wisetech, company-breakdown-anz, ...), summary close is summary-close-button, leaderboard close is leaderboard-close-button. Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run with pytest from /app/backend; pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope). Only remaining open item after a fix is verifying POST /api/regenerate-questions returns 200 within the ingress timeout through the public URL and that the UI shows the success toast + fresh 40-question grid.
rca_of_the_issue: The regenerate endpoint asks claude-sonnet-4-6 for 40 questions in one response. Measured local latency: 69.9s (200 OK, 41 questions). The Emergent preview ingress/Cloudflare edge terminates requests around 60s, returning an HTML 502 page, so both pytest and the browser see 502 while backend logs show a successful LiteLLM completion. Mitigation: fan out 5 smaller LLM calls concurrently.
